Priya S: Hi team — first day! my monitor arrived but only the panel came, no stand or screws. also can't join the office Wi‑Fi (keeps asking for cert). who should I ping for replacement stand and wifi help? :wave:
Simon (IT): welcome, Priya! sorry about that. Can you drop the order/tracking number? We'll raise a parts ticket. For Wi‑Fi, what's the exact SSID you're seeing?
Priya S: Thanks Simon. tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784 (fedex). SSID shows 'Redwood-Guest' and 'Redwood-Employee', but Employee prompts for a cert error: "TLS cert verify failed"
Simon (IT): got it. I created IT ticket #IT-2026-347 — it-bot should post details shortly. For the cert error, try this quick check on Mac: open Keychain Access -> System Roots -> search for "Redwood CA" and make sure it's trusted. If using Linux, run:
```bash
sudo cp /etc/ssl/certs/redwood.pem /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/
sudo update-ca-certificates
```
Priya S: i'm on a company Macbook (M2). don't see "Redwood CA" in System Roots. do we have a link to the cert?
it-bot: IT ticket created: IT-2026-347. Assigned to Simon (IT). ETA for parts: 3-5 business days. Add comments at https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-2026-347
Ben T: If you need a stand ASAP, we can ship a temporary VESA arm from Ops. ping me and I'll drop one to your desk. Also FYI some M2 macs need a firmware update for external displays to not flicker — check System Settings -> Software Update.
Priya S: thanks Ben — would love a temporary arm. Simon — any way to expedite the stand? the monitor is a 27" Samsung, the outer screw pattern is standard VESA 100.
Simon (IT): I'll mark the parts request as expedited in the ticket. In the meantime Ben's arm should help. Also attaching the cert link here: https://internal.redwood/certs/redwood-root.pem (store in Keychain -> login and set to Always Trust).
Priya S: tried adding the cert, still asking for username. Are we using Okta SSO for Wi‑Fi?
Simon (IT): Yes — it's EAP‑TTLS with your Red ID. Username is your corp email, password is your Okta app password. If you hit MFA, approve the push in Okta. If you're blocked, I'll remote in via AnyDesk at 3pm.
Lena (People Ops): Priya — welcome again! If you need any accessories beyond the arm (keyboard, dongles), reply here and we'll fast‑track.
Priya S: appreciate it all. Ben — can you drop the arm today? desk is 8C, I'll be there after lunch. Simon — remote at 3pm works. thanks :smile:
Simon (IT): noted. I'll update ticket IT-2026-347 with arm delivery and cert steps. Followups will be posted there.
Ben T: dropping off at 2:15pm. Priya: FYI bring any USB‑C to DisplayPort dongles if you have them, otherwise I can include one.
Priya S: I have a USB‑C hub but no DP cable. include one if possible. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
it-bot: Ticket IT-2026-347 status changed: In Progress -> Parts/Onsite. Expected resolution 2026-04-02.
Simon (IT): closing loop here, please comment on the ticket if anything new. If Wi‑Fi still fails after cert + Okta flow, ping me directly. Welcome aboard! :tada:
